summary: Bioclinic has a calm, premium look and a clear three step patient experience. The site has no way to book, and leftover text and broken links weaken the premium feel it is going for.

findings.problem: There is no booking form and no Book a consultation button. The main buttons only scroll or browse, and the header has no phone or WhatsApp button.
findings.cost: A visitor who likes the clinic has no direct next step and must hunt for a contact page. Many leave without booking.
findings.fix: A Book a consultation button in the header and hero with a short booking form and WhatsApp beside it.

findings.problem: There are no reviews, before and after cases, practitioner names or credentials, and no pricing guidance anywhere on the page.
findings.cost: Aesthetic patients decide on proof and on who will treat them. Without it, a premium look is not enough to win the booking.
findings.fix: Named clinicians with credentials, real reviews and captioned results with consent.

findings.problem: The Instagram menu item links to /#contact, and the Instagram section falls back to a Posts not showing message. Leftover text such as Hover or tap to turn and stray underscores in headings appear on the page.
findings.cost: Broken links and leftover text break the polished feel a premium clinic depends on, right where trust is built.
findings.fix: Working social links, a stable feed and clean headings.

findings.problem: Service cards rely on hover or tap to reveal what they offer, and a Staff login link sits in the public footer.
findings.cost: Mobile visitors may never see the treatments, and a staff link in public view looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Treatments shown clearly on mobile, and the staff login moved out of the visitor path.

redesign: A booking first homepage with a clear Book a consultation button, a short form and WhatsApp on every page.
A proof layer: named clinicians, real reviews and captioned results beside every booking button.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like skin treatments Yas Island and aesthetic clinic Abu Dhabi.
